description: This file contains end-to-end tests for managing Custom Profile Attributes (CPA) values in Mattermost, including listing and setting values of various types (text, select, multiselect, user) for users.

classes.name: MmctlE2ETestSuite
classes.description: Test suite for end-to-end testing of CPA value management in Mattermost.

methods.name: cleanCPAValuesForUser
methods.description: Removes all CPA values for a specified user by setting each to null.

methods.name: TestCPAValueList
methods.description: Tests listing CPA values for a user, both when no values are set and when values exist, verifying output formats.

methods.name: TestCPAValueSet
methods.description: Tests setting CPA values of various types (text, select, multiselect, user) for a user, verifying correct storage and retrieval.
